blinding_guess.why: All five listed elements are present and internally consistent (included gazebo/transmission macros reference joint and link names the macros create; material names used by lwa4d are defined in materials.urdf.xacro and schunk.material). Both macros require has_podest with no default, so callers that omit it fail. Outside the listed elements, pw70.transmission.xacro redefines schunk_pg70_transmission (for pan/tilt joints) and pw70.urdf.xacro calls an undefined schunk_pw70_transmission, so a robot that includes pw70 after pg70 would get the wrong transmissions from xacro:schunk_pg70. Nothing in the listed elements alone shows a defect.

notes: ROS 1 (indigo) description-only package: no topics, services, actions, messages or parameters; all five packet elements are provided xacro API (three installed file paths, two xacro macros). Port entries are recorded for completeness, but msg_type, frame, units, QoS (ROS 1, so null), rates and definition_id do not apply to xacro files or macros and are null; definition_hash.py covers only .msg/.srv/.action/.idl definitions. For the three file-path elements, the declaration line recorded is the file's root <robot> element, since a file has no single signature line; the files exist at urdf/lwa4d/lwa4d.urdf.xacro, urdf/materials.urdf.xacro and urdf/pg70/pg70.urdf.xacro and are installed by CMakeLists.txt:8-9. materials.urdf.xacro declares no xmlns:xacro namespace and uses no xacro constructs. lwa4d.urdf.xacro also defines a global property safety_offset (line 3, unprefixed <property>), a global macro axis_config (line 8) and schunk_lwa4d_custom (line 21, params parent name *origin has_podest invert_j1..invert_j7); schunk_lwa4d wraps schunk_lwa4d_custom with invert_j1-j7 fixed by use_factory_settings (lines 290-301). lwa4d.urdf.xacro and pg70.urdf.xacro use M_PI and xacro:default_inertial, which are defined in this package's urdf/common.xacro (not included by either file; the including file must include it). lwa4d and pg70 use the old unprefixed xacro tags <property> and <insert_block> alongside xacro:-prefixed tags. exclusive is empty: the transmissions (lwa4d.transmission.xacro: PositionJointInterface and VelocityJointInterface on ${name}_1_joint..${name}_7_joint; pg70.transmission.xacro: PositionJointInterface, VelocityJointInterface and EffortJointInterface on ${name}_finger_left_joint and ${name}_finger_right_joint) declare which hardware interfaces the joints expose; they do not claim any resource exclusively. No other package in the snapshot references the listed files or macros. pg70 finger links put <material> inside <collision> (lines 92-94, 126-128), which URDF does not define for collision.
